interpretation: Current-source ordinary before/after comparison; common benchmark and support objects; only native.cpp.o replaced. CPU0 sequential ABBA. All cases and both ordering edges retained; preflights excluded from timings.
prior_comparison: before-prior.csv uses current live baseline samples; after-prior.csv uses the isolated, uninstalled candidate. Each selects the fastest available explicit Ikea family and fastest retained prior for the fixed16/u64/4KiB case. Predecessor is same-wire LocalPack/ScanPack; Calico can use another representation. Compare provenance before quoting current gaps.

selection_curation.note: Git selection and local navigation changed; measured source, job, and full-bundle identities are unchanged.

units: CPU/real times are ns per benchmark iteration. ns_per_item uses the reported item rate; an item means what the benchmark counts, not necessarily a value or byte.
